description: This file defines the GuzzleHttp PsR7 Query class, which provides static methods to parse query strings into associative arrays and build query strings from arrays, used for handling URL query parameters within HTTP requests.

classes.name: Query
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to parse and build URL query strings.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a query string into an associative array, decoding URL-encoded characters based on specified encoding options.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs a URL query string from an array of parameters, encoding keys and values according to the specified encoding type.
